title_en: Bargain price! At Art in the Neighborhood, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale, Ideal Investment Opportunity!
description_en: Clearing opportunity! At Ex-Profarma, Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, with perfect floor plan, in new building!! The apartment has a total area of ​​114.8 m2 and is organized with the corridor that divides the living room together with the kitchen corner and access to the balcony, the matrimonial bedroom with its own toilet, the children's room and the day toilet. The apartment is located in a qualified and new area in terms of infrastructure, as well as a new, high-quality construction, with contemporary works where thermal insulation of the facade is noted, windows equipped with thermal double glazing, acoustic insulation, hydraulic systems of the Geberit brand, installations for a central heating - cooling multisplit system, three elevators of one of the most popular brands in the market. The construction is currently in the construction phase and is expected to be completed within 2 years.
